create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Create a new contact record in Respond.io.

identifier.description: Must be a unique identifier for the new contact. Use format: `email:user@example.com` or `phone:+60123456789`.

email.description: The email address of the contact.

phone.description: The phone number of the contact (in E.164 format).

profilePic.description: A direct URL to the contact's profile picture.

customFields.description: Add custom fields for the contact.

- Text: "string" (use quotation marks)
- Number: 123 (without quotation marks)
- Email: "user@domain.com"
- URL: "https://example.com"
- Date: "yyyy-mm-dd"
- Time: "HH:MM" (24H format)
- Checkbox: "true" or "false"

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in Respond.io, keyed by a unique identifier in `email:...` or `phone:...` form. Use only when adding a brand-new contact; if the contact may already exist, prefer Create or Update Contact, which upserts. Requires the identifier and first name; optional email, phone, language, country, profile picture, and custom fields. Not idempotent — intended to create a fresh record.

email.description: The email address of the contact.

phone.description: The phone number of the contact (in E.164 format).

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a Respond.io contact keyed by a unique identifier in `id:...`, `email:...`, or `phone:...` form: updates the matching contact if it exists, otherwise creates one. Prefer this over Create Contact when the contact may already exist. Requires the identifier and first name; optional email, phone, language, country, profile picture, and custom fields. Idempotent — repeating with the same input converges to the same record.

webhookInstructions.description:
To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Respond.io account:

			1. Login to your Respond.io account.
			2. Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks.
			3. Click on "Add Webhook" or "Create New Webhook".
			4. Add the following URL in the **Webhook URL** field:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			5. Select **contact.tag.updated** from the event types.
			6. Click Save to create the webhook.
